turns.text: ok so sam left early again today.. i opened at 6:30 and he bailed like an hour before close and i just covered it. he still owes me two saturday shifts from september btw

That's frustrating, especially covering his last hour on top of your own early open. Do you want to bring it up with him, or find a way to make the shifts more even without a big talk? Also, what time does your shift end on Saturdays?
we end at 1. and idk i dont want to like confront him. is there a way to handle it without it being a Thing

Yes, you can keep it low-key and still be clear:

- Send a casual text, not a face-to-face: "hey, can we sort out the saturday schedule? i've got the two shifts from september on my list, want to pick dates for those?"
- Frame it as logistics, not blame: "just trying to keep the splits even."
- Suggest specific dates so he doesn't have to figure it out.
- If you have a manager who sets the schedule, you can ask them to put the makeup shifts on the calendar, so it's just the schedule saying so.

Want me to draft the text?
yes pls but softer. also jun sold out of lumpia at the counter this morning and the line was a hassle so i was kinda slammed already

That explains the rough morning. Here's a softer version:

"hey sam! saturday got kinda hectic, so i was thinking we could sketch out the next few weekends together. i think you still have two shifts from september to make up, could we pick dates? no rush, just want to get them on the calendar ☕"

If he leaves early again, you can add: "can we plan an end time ahead so neither of us gets caught off guard?" Want to tweak the tone?
thats good. ok now the afternoon. i work sunday too so i dont want to wreck myself. can u make a plan w times

Sure. Tell me when you're free to start and anything fixed, and I'll block it. Here's a starter, assuming you're done at 1:

- 1:30 eat something real and sit down
- 2:00-3:30 your main study or errands block
- 3:30 short walk or break
- 4:00-5:30 lighter tasks, prep for tomorrow
- 6:00 dinner
- 9:00 wind down, set out what you need for Sunday's early start
- 10:30 bed, since you're up early again

What do you need to fit in?
ok add rice bowl prep for sunday lunches, can u give me a short grocery and prep list pls. bullets

Rice bowl prep, bullets:

**Grocery**
- rice
- a protein (chicken thighs, tofu or eggs)
- 2 veggies (broccoli, carrots or cabbage)
- a sauce (soy, sesame oil or chili crisp)
- scallions

**Prep (about 45 min)**
- start the rice
- roast or pan-cook the protein
- steam or sauté the veggies
- portion into containers, keep sauce separate

Put it at 4:00 in your plan. Then you've got lunch ready for tomorrow.
perfect thank u. ok im gonna eat now 🫠
Go eat! Good luck with the text to Sam, and have an easy Sunday shift.
